kill_criterion.frozen_rule: unresolved failed-pass targets exceed 10% OR audit reliability is poor

human_audit.reason: No blinded human review of failed-pass targets has been performed. The reviewer columns of artifacts/stage2_ambiguous_audit.csv are blank and must stay blank; inventing reviewer_decision, reviewer_confidence, reviewer_is_intended_target, or reviewer_reason values would manufacture evidence that does not exist. Stage 2 is therefore accepted under the narrow path instead of under the frozen audit gate.
human_audit.reopens_lock_only_if: A blinded human review of every ambiguous failure, the required random auto-accepted sample, and the completed controls is recorded; per-fold decision rules are re-selected against training-fold audit labels; the strict and pre-audit unresolved rates are recomputed; and a new Stage 2 lock revision is issued.

reliable_receiver_specific_outcomes: completed passes with a known receiver inside the candidate set

conditionally_reliable.requires: A downstream stage may add auto-accepted inferred failures to a receiver-specific analysis only if that stage also reports the same analysis with them excluded (explicit sensitivity check), and labels them provisional/unaudited in every table and figure.
conditionally_reliable.never: treated as an audited failed-pass precision claim

completed_pass_proxy.measures: top-1 agreement and auto-accept precision on held-out COMPLETED passes
forbidden_uses: citing held-out completed-pass auto-accept precision as failed-pass precision
citing it as evidence that inferred failed targets are audited or validated
using it to justify receiver-specific failed-pass claims
completed_pass_proxy.required_caveat: A completed pass reaches its receiver and is geometrically easier than an intercepted pass, so this number is an optimistic upper bound on failed-pass precision, not an estimate of it. The project self-check failed_residuals_within_completed_support already fails, showing accepted failures sit outside the completed-correct residual support.

assertions.rule: no candidate row and no inferred_targetId may equal interceptorId
usable_as_receiver_completion_label may only be True where target_reliability_status == known_receiver and true_receiverId is not null
usable_as_named_failed_target may only be True where decision == auto_accept and inferred_targetId is not null
every required gate column exists on every gated table
while human_audit.status != complete, every reviewer column in artifacts/stage2_ambiguous_audit.csv must be blank

must: join tables/stage2_label_eligibility.parquet and filter on the gate columns
train passability completion labels on receiver_specific_eligible == True only
treat every failed pass as touch-level turnover evidence, not receiver-attributed
carry target_reliability_status through to any receiver-level output
must_not: use ambiguous or unresolved failed passes as named-receiver completion labels
report receiver-specific failed-pass rates without the exclusion sensitivity check
describe Stage 2 failed-pass targets as audited or validated
